name: 83605 · Caldwell, ID
findings: ZIP 83605 (Caldwell) has 104 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83605 (Caldwell) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
